close_reason: Historical commit message mismatch; commit 39f1964d contains only target/.rustc_info.json. No code change possible.
description: Commit 39f1964d ('refactor: replace ref patterns and empty string literals (idiom pass)') has a diff that only touches target/.rustc_info.json — a build artifact. The actual Rust source changes described by the commit message appear to be in the earlier commit c350d2b0 (which has the same message prefix). HEAD~3 is an empty/artifact-only commit with a misleading message. This should be investigated: either the wrong commit was pushed (the Rust file changes got folded into c350d2b0 without being listed in HEAD~3), or the commit was created empty by accident. Low severity but creates confusion during bisect and archaeology.
title: commit HEAD~3 message doesn't match diff content
